description: This file is a shell script that manages the lifecycle of review cycles for components in a software project. It provides commands to start, stop, and clear review dates stored within component metadata files, and includes helper functions for date calculations and report regeneration.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components by locating metadata.yaml files excluding documentation and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the path to a component's metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a future date by adding a specified number of business days, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets review-related dates in metadata.yaml to a placeholder (tildes).

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls an external script to regenerate the RAG status report.
